verdict.rationale: Ashby documents an official MCP Server that exposes live recruiting context to MCP-compatible clients like ChatGPT, Claude, and Cursor without custom middleware. It covers candidates, applications, jobs, interviews, offers, notes, feedback, and more, and a probe confirms the official MCP page exists. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the server working, detailed setup/auth and connection documentation, evidence of write/action tools beyond search and retrieval.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server

citations.quote: With Ashby’s MCP Server, customers can make live recruiting context from Ashby available to MCP-compatible AI clients like ChatGPT, Claude, Cursor, and others, without building custom middleware or maintaining a bespoke integration.
Search and retrieve recruiting context across candidates, applications, jobs, job postings, interviews, offers, notes, feedback, emails, referrals, hiring teams, and other recruiting records.
